summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for LifeChart – a patient-friendly lifelong health timeline web app for India's ABDM ecosystem. Covers project architecture (Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind + Zustand), all 9 pages, mock data layer, AI OCR via Gemini Vision, ABDM integration stubs, consent/QR system, family management, emergency card, Hindi/English i18n, and the design system.
